tools.name: scenario_ask_copilot
tools.title: Ask the scenario copilot what to fix
tools.description: Ask the scenario copilot what to fix, or run its readiness review. Proposes actions, applies none.

scenario_id.description: The scenario (id or name); default: the only one of this workspace.

message.description: The question for the scenario copilot.

review.description: true: the standard readiness review instead of a question (not with message).

profile.description: The load profile to discuss; default: the chosen one.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: scenario_save
tools.title: Save a scenario's name, tags, active flag or SLO thresholds
tools.description: Save a scenario's name, tags, active flag or SLO thresholds (no id: create an empty one).

scenario_id.description: The scenario to change (id or name); without it, a new empty scenario is created.

name.description: The name; required for a new scenario.

tags.description: Tags, comma-separated (at most 20); replaces the list, an empty text clears it.

slo_thresholds.description: SLO thresholds (key: number); {} sets the standard SLO.

slo_from_project.description: true: drop the scenario's own SLO thresholds; it inherits the project's.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: scenario_save_composition
tools.title: Save a composition
tools.description: Save a composition (members, weights, load profile; no id: create), validating it. Direct edit, only on request; see scenario_suggest_split.

composition_id.description: The composition to change (id or name); without it, a new one is created.

name.description: The name; required for a new composition.

members.description: Scenario (id or name) -> its share in percent (0-100); replaces the member list, a member that stays keeps its settings. Required for a new composition.

profile.description: The composition's load profile (users, ramp, duration), as scenario_get_composition shows it.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.

tools.name: scenario_set_composition_type
tools.title: Set a composition's load test type
tools.description: Set a composition's load test type; members are re-linked and data re-sized.

composition_id.description: The composition: its id or name; default: the one of this workspace.

type.description: The kind of test the composition runs.

spec.description: The parameters of that kind; LoadCraft checks them. All kinds take target_users and duration_seconds (positive whole numbers, required) and optionally ramp_up_seconds, think_time_ms, max_duration_seconds. By kind: load_test ramp_down_seconds; stress_test stress_multiplier (above 1); spike_test spike_users (required) and spike_duration_seconds; breakpoint_test step_users, step_duration_seconds, max_steps; capacity_test target_rps. Do not repeat type here; other fields are refused.

format.description: Read-only choice of the answer: "text" (default) is the view; "data" is the same facts as one JSON block, for a client that parses them.
